<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Adding a "train yourself" tutorial stage so students can practice training before seeing the computer's approach.

The overlay opens automatically after the data stage. A tutorial caption guides the student. Clicking Next closes the overlay and advances to the grow stage.

The overlay will reopen if the student returns to this stage from the grow step. Sidebar step info in stages.ts also needs updating.

A useEffect hook will sync the overlay state with the current tutorial stage. The tree view will be hidden during this stage since the overlay covers the entire screen. The new stage also needs entries in types.ts, stages.ts, and tutorial.ts.

ForestDemo.tsx will handle the overlay auto-open and close logic. The tree panel can remain visible since the overlay covers the screen. Need to decide whether TrainYourselfOverlay requires a tutorial prop to restrict closing until the Next button is pressed.

Escape key and manual close will be disabled during the tutorial stage. The overlay will reopen if closed, or stay locked until the Next button advances. This prevents students from skipping ahead by exiting the overlay.
</details></think>
